plugin.plugin_jellyfin.name: Jellyfin
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.description: Jellyfin for Discord: library search, now playing, random picks, recommendations, Jellyseerr requests, account linking with a role, and new-content notices.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.status.label: Jellyfin status
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.status.descr: Server state, playbacks and your link.
Active playbacks in the shared libraries.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.search.label: Jellyfin search
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.search.descr: Finds a title in the shared libraries.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.random.label: Random pick
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.random.descr: A random title; with a command it answers itself with an "Again" button.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.recommend.de: Unwatched title in the member's favourite genre.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.request.desc: Requests a movie or show in Jellyseerr.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.link.label: Link Jellyfin account
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.link.descrip: Starts Quick Connect: the member enters a code in Jellyfin (profile → Quick Connect).
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.unlink_accou: Removes the link and the linked role.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.setting.libraries: Pick the libraries the bot may search and show. The list shows every library of your connected Jellyfin servers as "Server:Library"; it updates when the bot starts and every 30 minutes.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.setting.linked_ro: Given after /jellyfin-link, taken away by /jellyfin-unlink. Must be below the bot's role.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.setting.new_conte: New titles (Jellyfin webhook plugin → webhook "media", notification "Item Added").
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.setting.announce_: Posts when a linked member starts watching (webhook "media", notification "Playback Start").
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.setting.jellyseer: Needs the secrets JELLYSEERR_URL (address incl. /api/v1) and JELLYSEERR_KEY (Admin → API / Secrets), shared with this plugin.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.favorites_ad: Adds the first Jellyfin hit for a title to the member's favorites.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.favorites_re: Removes a title from the member's favorites.
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.play.label: Play from Jellyfin
plugin.plugin_jellyfin.node.play.descrip: Plays a song, album, artist or playlist of the shared Jellyfin music libraries in the member's voice channel (the bot's music queue).
